title: RFC004 Model Component Lock (§39, v0.1 — A0 subset)
$comment: Closed envelope; not the RFC003 dataset Component Lock. A0 models the D0-style subset: 19 component kinds implementable today with a flat {kind, version, artifact_sha256 | semantic_hash} record. Deferred to later A-phases (§39.2 full list): visual_compressor, resource_recovery/materializer, fragment_assembler, ast_builder/canonicalizer/validator versions, confidence_calibrator, acceptance_policy, report_projection_registry, result_identity_projection, acceptance_reason_code_registry, speculator config/checkpoint, model_stage_registry, checkpoint_manifest and runtime_lock ArtifactRef envelopes. The bare ambiguous kind 'dflash' is forbidden by §39.3. Provisional kinds — present in this enum but NOT named in §39.2, so §39.2 does not mandate them and a lock omitting them is not thereby incomplete: 'model_capability_profile' (pending RR-4 in docs/plans/spec-dense-v0-m1-exact-text-design.md §4.8; §41.2 makes a new capability profile MINOR, which authorizes a new profile, not a new lock kind). 'composite_vocabulary' is NOT provisional: §39.2 names 'structural tokenizer/vocabulary'. Before treating any kind here as §39.2-mandated, check it against that list. MINOR addition (RFC004-ERRATA-005 E3/W1-7, ADRF/VC Wave 1): 'reasoning_module', 'reasoning_gate', 'pre_encoder_compressor', 'visual_compressor' (the last removed from the deferred list above). No producer emits any of the four yet -- see `unflatten.model.reasoning.lock` for the missing-weight hard load error §23 requires once one does. Adding these enum members does not change any existing lock document's bytes or hash: this schema file is never itself hashed into a Component Lock identity.

component.$comment: Exactly one of artifact_sha256 (raw SHA-256 of exact artifact bytes) or semantic_hash (domain-separated §3.1 deterministic-CBOR semantic hash) — the raw-vs-semantic distinction is load-bearing and the two must never be assumed equal.
